title: 蓝色保护印章  (The Heritage Stamp)

segments.t: Twenty minutes later inside Room Nine, the heritage review has checked every window, exit, book basket, and teacup—and Manager Zhou and Qing step over to Teacher Song by the piano holding a stamped white certificate! Listen first.
宋老师！快看周经理那页纸最下面的蓝色圆印章！
批准通过！正式街坊老建筑咖啡馆兼客栈——租约保住了！
恭喜您，周经理！办事员怎么评价九号房的？
她喝完了一整杯薄荷茶，把柠檬挞吃得一干二净，还笑了！
她说修复一间藏在一楼的阳光房，而不是砌新墙，简直太聪明了！
小美在厨房门口垫着靠垫，自豪地看完了全过程呢！
办事员走出梧桐巷以前，还问这架核桃木钢琴是不是真能弹。
宋老师，现在就为大家弹一遍吧——我姑姑写完的《小院圆舞曲》！
小晴，把对着院子的窗户大敞开，让小美和整栋楼都能听见。
窗户全都大敞开了，下午的微风吹进来了——宋老师，您随时开始！
听那开头的四个音符，飘到我们院子的大树底下了……
献给您的姑姑，周经理，也献给九号房。
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
宋老师！快看周经理那页纸最下面的蓝色圆印章！

'Teacher Song! Look at the round blue stamp at the bottom of Manager Zhou's page!' Unlike English, Mandarin zooms in from big to small—"Manager Zhou's that page's very-bottom"—before naming the blue stamp at the end.
批准通过！正式街坊老建筑咖啡馆兼客栈——租约保住了！

'Approved! Official neighbourhood heritage cafe and guesthouse—our lease is protected!' That single linking word between "cafe" and "guesthouse" means "serving as both at once", common on shopfront titles.
恭喜您，周经理！办事员怎么评价九号房的？
'Congratulations, Manager Zhou! What did the clerk say about Room Nine?' The word for "congratulations" joins "respectful" with "joy", heard everywhere at weddings, openings, and holidays.
她喝完了一整杯薄荷茶，把柠檬挞吃得一干二净，还笑了！

'She drank a whole cup of mint tea, ate every last crumb of lemon tart, and smiled!' Qing uses a colourful number idiom—"one-dry-two-clean"—meaning she polished off the tart without leaving a single crumb.
她说修复一间藏在一楼的阳光房，而不是砌新墙，简直太聪明了！

'She said restoring a hidden ground-floor sunroom instead of building walls was genius!' Here the Mandarin word for "building a wall" carries the stone symbol on its left, from laying courses of brick or stone.
小美在厨房门口垫着靠垫，自豪地看完了全过程呢！
'And Mei, propped on her cushion at the kitchen doorway, proudly watched the whole thing!' "Cushion" literally says "lean-pad", naming a pillow by how it supports your back or resting ankle.
办事员走出梧桐巷以前，还问这架核桃木钢琴是不是真能弹。

'Before walking out to Wutong Lane, the clerk asked if the walnut piano really plays.' In Mandarin, pianos, cameras, and airplanes share a counter built from the image of a wooden frame holding equipment upright.
宋老师，现在就为大家弹一遍吧——我姑姑写完的《小院圆舞曲》！

'Play it for all of us right now, Teacher Song—my aunt's finished "Courtyard Waltz"!' After "play", Zhou adds a handy word that means "one complete run from start to finish", ideal for a whole piece of music.
小晴，把对着院子的窗户大敞开，让小美和整栋楼都能听见。
'Open the courtyard windows wide, Qing, so Mei and the whole building can hear.' Mandarin builds "hear" in two steps: "listen" for turning your ear, plus "perceive" to confirm the sound reaches you.
窗户全都大敞开了，下午的微风吹进来了——宋老师，您随时开始！
'Windows wide open, afternoon breeze coming in—whenever you're ready, Teacher Song!' "Whenever" literally means "follow-time"—"at whatever moment suits you"—a gracious way to invite someone to begin.
听那开头的四个音符，飘到我们院子的大树底下了……
'Listen to those first four notes floating out under our courtyard tree...' The word for "floating" carries the wind symbol on its right side, picturing notes or petals drifting on air.
献给您的姑姑，周经理，也献给九号房。
'For your aunt, Manager Zhou, and for Room Nine.' Teacher Song opens with the formal dedication word "offered-to", the exact phrase printed at the front of books and concert scores.
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.
宋老师！快看周经理那页纸最下面的蓝色圆印章！
批准通过！正式街坊老建筑咖啡馆兼客栈——租约保住了！
恭喜您，周经理！办事员怎么评价九号房的？

小美在厨房门口垫着靠垫，自豪地看完了全过程呢！
办事员走出梧桐巷以前，还问这架核桃木钢琴是不是真能弹。
宋老师，现在就为大家弹一遍吧——我姑姑写完的《小院圆舞曲》！
小晴，把对着院子的窗户大敞开，让小美和整栋楼都能听见。
窗户全都大敞开了，下午的微风吹进来了——宋老师，您随时开始！
听那开头的四个音符，飘到我们院子的大树底下了……
献给您的姑姑，周经理，也献给九号房。
The blue heritage stamp is dry on the page, the lease is safe, and 'Courtyard Waltz' floats out through the open green shutters for the first time! See you next time.
再见！
